plan.title: bug(hooks): active-scope write gate skips outside-project-root targets

narratives.Description: Skip active-scope deny for Write/Edit when resolved target is outside projectRoot; keep fail-closed on null targets. Out-of-repo Write is denied scope-not-ready while shell tools bypass the same gate, incentivizing unaudited paths.
narratives.Overview: Valid #2885. Over-broad scope-not-ready on out-of-repo agent memory/tmp writes.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent writing outside the project checkout, I want the active-scope write gate to skip out-of-root targets, so that empty xbrief/active does not block legitimate agent memory or temp files.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts inspectMutationGates — before scope deny, compute hookWriteTargetPath and toProjectRelativePosix; if rel.startsWith('..') and not spawn, skip active-scope deny. Step 2: null writeTarget remains fail-closed. Step 3: packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.test.ts cases for outside-root allow, null deny, spawn still requires scope. Step 4: CHANGELOG #2885. Verification: task test -- packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher; task check:merge. Touch concrete source files listed in plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance criteria map to #2885; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps lines.

narrative.Acceptance: Given empty xbrief/active/ and absolute write target outside projectRoot, when tool.before Write/Edit runs, then decision is not scope-not-ready (ritual may still apply).
Given Write payload with no extractable path and empty active/, when gate runs, then still denies (cannot skip via unparseable payload).
Given spawn tool and empty active/, when gate runs, then spawn-not-ready still applies (no write target).
Given PR, when tests run, then outside-root allow and null fail-closed cases pass; CHANGELOG cites #2885.
